turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Hi! Where are you? I've been at the Museum Café for fifteen minutes.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Hi! I'm at the Library Café. I think we've mixed something up.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Really? I was sure you said the museum. We met there last week.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: We were supposed to meet at the Library Café. My message said "Library Café at six". It's the one next to the City Library.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Oh, you're right. I can see it now. Sorry! So what should we do? The film starts at seven thirty.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: The cafés are about twenty minutes apart. How far is the cinema from you?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: It's only ten minutes from here. From the library it's about fifteen.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Then I could walk to you now. I'd be there at about six thirty-five, so we'd still have time for a coffee.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That makes sense. I'll order for you. What would you like?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: A cappuccino, please. So, the Museum Café at about six thirty-five, then the cinema at seven thirty.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Perfect. See you soon. And sorry again!
